research_mode: official Ministry of Justice accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Remand not applicable or unknown
verified_claims: In 81% of magistrates' cases the remand decision was not applicable or unknown, reflecting Single Justice Procedure volumes.
limitations: High missing or non-applicable status prevents unsupported remand inference.

sources.name: Indictable remand custody
verified_claims: About 13,100 defendants for indictable offences were remanded in custody at magistrates' courts.
limitations: Court-category totals are not spatial risk measures.

sources.name: Either-way remand custody
verified_claims: About 47,500 defendants for triable-either-way offences were remanded in custody at magistrates' courts.
limitations: The total cannot be mapped to a parcel.

sources.name: Crown Court remand custody
verified_claims: Around 57,900 defendants were remanded in custody at the Crown Court.
limitations: National court remand volume is not local incident evidence.

sources.name: Crown Court custody share
verified_claims: The Crown Court custody-remand proportion was 54% in 2025.
limitations: A court-process proportion cannot be used as parcel risk.

sources.name: Crown Court bail share
verified_claims: The Crown Court bail proportion was 45% in 2025.
limitations: The bail share has no exact-address interpretation.

sources.name: Remanded custody sentencing outcome
verified_claims: Of those remanded in custody at the Crown Court, 79% received immediate or suspended custody.
limitations: Case outcomes reflect selected defendants and cannot describe parcel safety.

sources.name: Bailed sentencing outcome
verified_claims: Of those bailed at the Crown Court, 52% received immediate or suspended custody.
limitations: The comparison is case-based and not spatially attributable.

sources.name: Offenders sentenced
verified_claims: 1.20 million offenders were sentenced in 2025, 1% more than the previous year.
limitations: Sentencing volumes do not measure exact local public safety.

sources.name: Fine sentence share
verified_claims: Fines accounted for 77% of sentences, with summary motoring offences accounting for 76% of fines.
limitations: Sentence composition reflects case mix and cannot be used for parcel scoring.
